topic: Parts and functions of the ear
key_concepts: The pinna is the visible outer ear and collects sound waves
The ear canal is the passage for sound to reach the eardrum
The eardrum is a thin stretched piece of skin that vibrates when sound reaches it
The hammer, anvil, and stirrup are three small bones that vibrate when the eardrum vibrate
The cochlea is a snail-shaped part filled with liquid that sends messages to the auditory
The auditory nerve tells the brain what sound is heard
Sound travels from the pinna through the ear canal to the eardrum, small bones, cochlea, a
The ears are important for hearing
Use a clean cloth to wipe the outer ear
A doctor should check the ears for any problem
Never insert sharp objects or anything inside the ear
